description: Coordinate format converter — Convert any coordinate between decimal degrees, DMS, DDM, UTM, MGRS, geohash and Open Location Code (plus code), offline WGS84. Pass q= in any of those formats (auto-detected) or lat= and lon=. Optional hemisphere=S for southern UTM written without a band letter. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_coords
